issue.title: [Smartswitch] DPUs are not powered off on Switch startup if there is no config entry for admin state present

failure.body:
On switch startup if there is no admin state configuration in CONFIG_DB, the DPUs are supposed to be powered off (dark mode requirement). This was working with the chassisd implementation previously but on the merged commit this change seems to be reverted in this commit https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/467/commits/bd416b9b14b3588178ff98f7b53bd35a397ddb4d

Scenario for reproduction:

- All DPUs powered on,
-  reboot the switch with no `CHASSIS_MODULE|DPU*` config in the CONFIG_DB,
- DPUs will stay powered on

resolution.title: Fix for bug-21459: Set the initial DPU admin state
resolution.description:
#### Description
 Set the initial DPU admin state to "down" for DPUs that don't have the "CHASSIS_MODULE" configured.  The default is "down"

Fixes:  sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#21459

#### Motivation and Context

The chassisd config change handler is not triggering the config change event the very first time.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
The new set of smartswitch tests added into sonic-mgmt
